note: Pinned teacher candidates. Revisions are Hugging Face commit SHAs resolved from /api/models/<id>. Files are fetched verbatim; no file is generated or transformed. Weights live in the persistent HF cache and are never committed.

models.role: non-binding control: the full dense model is below the 1e9 unique-active ceiling
ceiling-binding teacher: dense weights exceed 1e9 while the always-on backbone remains below it

reference_models_not_downloaded.reason: Accounting on the real configs shows its always-active backbone exceeds the 1e9 ceiling, so it cannot be a compliant teacher even with zero FFN groups. Downloading it would not answer a compliance question; see docs/BUDGET-MATH.md.
